title: Introduction to Business Education
topics: Meaning and scope of business education

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Business educator.
o: the official document that states the aims and structure of Nigerian education
a graduate who teaches business subjects and advises on enterprise
the rule that every transaction is entered in two accounts
the sequence of jobs a person holds in a chosen line of work
items.s: Business educator: a graduate who teaches business subjects and advises on enterprise. The other options describe Double entry, Career, National Policy on Education.
